description: Lists every SmartBear product this server supports, whether it is configured for this connection, and for unconfigured products the environment variable or HTTP header each setting needs. Only products allowed by the server's MCP_CLIENTS setting are listed. Products that accept per-request OAuth tokens (BearQ, Reflect, QMetry) always show as configured. Takes no parameters.
name: smartbear_list_integrations
title: SmartBear: List Integrations
